title: Austin Housing Aid: Approvals on Hold
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation convened to consider significant forgivable loans totaling over $1.3 million for various affordable housing projects.
*   Proposed funding included assistance for first-time homebuyers in the Guadalupe and Springdale/Webberville neighborhoods, and support for multifamily transitional housing.
*   Additionally, a substantial loan was on the table to help rehabilitate affordable multifamily rental housing in multiple locations.
*   Despite these critical initiatives, all major items on the agenda, including the housing loans and a briefing on current housing programs, were unanimously postponed for one week.

THURSDAY. NOVEMBER 2.2000
The Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened at 10:17
a.m. The following agenda were the AHFC items considered by the Austin Housing Finance
Corporation's Board of Directors.
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING OF AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE COPRORATION
AHFC-1. 
Approval of minutes for Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called
Meeting of October 12,2000.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called
Meeting of September 12, 2000 was approved on Vice President Goodman's
motion, Board Member Alvarez* second by a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-2. 
Staff will give a briefing to the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Board regarding
housing programs and current year housing initiatives.
This motion to postpone this item for one week at staffs request was approved
on Board Member Alvarez* motion, President Watson's second by a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-3. 
Approve a Resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a Community
Housing Development Organization (CHDO) Program forgivable loan in an amount
not to exceed $146,000 to the Guadalupe Neighborhood Development Corporation to
provide principle buy-down and closing cost assistance to four (4) first-time
homebuyers of new single-family homes in the Guadalupe Neighborhood.
This motion to postponed this item for one week at staffs request was approved
on Board Member Thomas* motion, Board Member Alvarez* second by a 7-0
vote.
AHFC-4. 
Approve a Resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a Community
Housing Development Organization (CHDO) Program forgivable loan in the amount
not to exceed $75,600 to American Youthworks, Inc. to assist in lot acquisition and
construction of three (3) single-family homes for low and moderate income first-time
homebuyers in the Springdale/Webberville Neighborhood.
This motion to postponed this item for one week at staffs request was approved
on Board Member Thomas* motion, Board Member Alvarez* second by a 7-0
vote.
AHFC-5. 
Approve a Resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a Community
Housing Development Organization (CHDO) Program forgivable loan in the amount
not to exceed $500,000 to the Mary Lee Foundation to assist in the acquisition of
multifamily transitional housing located at 1322 and 1324 Lamar Square Drive.
This motion to postponed this item for one week at staff's request was approved
on Board Member Thomas' motion, Board Member Alvarez' second by a 7-0
vote.
AHFC-6. 
Approve a Resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a Community
Housing Development Organization (CHDO) Program forgivable loan in an amount
not to exceed $650,000 to the Texas Reinvestment Corporation to assist in the
rehabilitation of affordable multifamily rental housing located at 2221/2225 Elmont
Drive and 2222 Townlake Circle.
This motion to postponed this item for week at staffs request was approved on
Board Member Thomas' motion, Board Member Alvarez' second by a 7-0 vote.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 10:20 a.m. was approved on Vice President Goodman's
motion, Board Member Alvarez' second by a 7-0 vote.
The motion to approve the minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation
Special Called Meeting of November 2, 2000 was approved on Board Member Wynn's
motion, Board Member Alvarez' second by a 7-0 vote.
